title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027 for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 22 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.
AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

You mentioned a focus on customers with volume. Our attached packages commit 23,700 kg a year for 24 or 36 months. That gives you a secure base load and planning certainty, with a fixed price and no clause administration. Which package works best for you?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027 for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We acknowledge the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices, and we value your volume commitment of 23,700 kg per year. While this allows us to offer a substantial price reduction, a fixed price over 24 months is not possible, requiring us to apply the AS-14404 index clause. 

We therefore propose €5.30 per unit for a 24-month term, maintaining your preferred 30-day payment terms. Our offer is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. This option includes a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – revised package for 2027–2028
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking our data into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We have moved our price in the attached package. It keeps 23,700 kg a year for 24 months on 60 days net. A fixed price spares both sides the monthly clause administration and gives you a planned base load in line with your focus on customers with volume.

Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation. We would welcome that if it helps settle the price.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised package for 2027–2028
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We are pleased to offer the 60-day payment terms and 24-month contract you requested, provided we apply the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price is not feasible. Our offer stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

We propose €5.10 per unit with this clause, and we ask to schedule a meeting to walk you through our calculation as suggested. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit, with terms of a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the clause alternatives.

We have moved our price again in the attached package. It keeps the same terms: 23,700 kg a year for 24 months, 60 days net. The fixed price removes the monthly surcharge calculation and invoicing corrections on your side. It also gives your planning a firm base load for two years, in line with your focus on customers with volume.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer, but we must reiterate that a fixed price over 24 months is not possible, requiring the AS-14404 index clause. In response to your movement, we can reduce our price to €4.90 per unit for the 24-month term at 60 days net. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our Angebot is a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. It stays valid for 7 days. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.00 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, Zahlungsziel 60 days net.

You mentioned the value of a firm base load; please provide the exact binding volume figures you can commit to. Which volume can you commit to? We look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
